device.title: Choose an opener
device.description: Choose an opener and close Smart Life to release Bluetooth. Keys will be retrieved automatically, then HA tests BLE without moving the window. Add the integration again for a second opener.

manual.title: Import O-Air credentials
manual.description: Paste the contents of credentials.mobile-qr.local.json. Keys are saved locally in Home Assistant. Close Smart Life and keep the opener within Bluetooth range.

menu_options.qr_login: Sign in with Smart Life QR

qr_login.title: Sign in to Smart Life
qr_login.description: Enter your Smart Life account country calling code and region. No password or User Code is needed. Internet is used only to retrieve device keys.

data_description.region: eu: Europe, us: Americas, sg: Singapore, cn: China, in: India.

scan.title: Approve Smart Life sign-in
scan.description: Open the QR scanner in Smart Life, scan this code, and approve sign-in. Then select Continue. To replace an expired code, select Generate a new QR code and continue.

error.invalid_credentials: The JSON must contain O-Air UUID, device_id, local_key and sec_key from the mobile QR export.
error.not_found: The matching O-Air was not found. Check your Bluetooth adapter or connectable proxy, range, and close Smart Life.
error.cannot_connect: Could not establish an encrypted BLE session. Check the keys, range, and close Smart Life.
error.qr_failed: Could not complete the Smart Life request. Check internet access and account region, then try a new QR code.
error.qr_pending: Sign-in has not been approved. Scan the QR with Smart Life, approve sign-in, and continue.
error.qr_expired: The QR code has expired. Generate a new code.
error.invalid_country: Enter the country calling code using digits, for example 7.
error.invalid_region: Select the Smart Life account region.
error.no_devices: No O-Air devices were found. Check your account and region, or use a saved JSON export.
error.missing_keys: Smart Life did not return a complete localKey/secKey pair and UUID for this O-Air. Sign in again or use a saved JSON export.
error.identity_mismatch: The device identity did not match the Smart Life response. Sign in again.
